title: SCO Forum backs Joint UNESCO bids, steps against heritage trafficking
description: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation's first Civilisational Dialogue Forum concluded in New Delhi with a joint communique. It advocated collaboration on securing UNESCO recognition to protect cultural heritage from illicit trafficking and disasters. The forum also encouraged the use of technology, including artificial intelligence, to enhance accessibility to cultural heritage. Delegates from member countries discussed shared cultural heritage, art, and historical trade relations over three days.
